The '''X-86 rocket launcher''' was a model of single-use disposable [[Missile launcher/Legends|rocket launcher]] in use during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[House Ulgo]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] used a number of X-86 launchers.
